name: HSE — health regions
description: HSE guidance describing the six health regions, regional responsibilities and local decision-making structure used to organise public health and social care in the Republic of Ireland.
intended_use: Use to scope regional service evidence and prevent one local service example from becoming a national rule.
audience_or_context: People and professionals in the Republic of Ireland navigating HSE regional service variation.
limitations: The HSE remains one national organisation, but service availability can vary below national level.
Region boundaries and Integrated Health Area structures can change and need review.
A region description does not itself establish access to a particular neurodevelopmental service.
conflicts_of_interest: HSE describes its own organisational geography; ND Oracle uses it for scope containment rather than to infer service quality or availability.

provenance.method: HSE health-regions page checked on 2026-09-04 for six-region structure, local decision-making and national HSE governance. Listing is descriptive and claimless.
